results.fact: Approach line from camp to the 7,200 ft col (Terror Glacier vs Barrier/Crescent Creek Basin)
results.correct_value: From Terror Basin camp: benches and slabs to the glacial lake outlet, across the Terror Glacier, then the snow gully to the 7,200 ft Inspiration-McMillan col. The Barrier/Crescent Creek is not on this route.
results.evidence: The Barrier is the ridge on the west side of Terror Basin separating it from Crescent Creek Basin, crossed only to reach Crescent Creek Basin climbs (Chopping Block, Terror West Ridge); the Barrier waypoint note reproduces that description. West McMillan parties go from camp over benches and slabs downhill to the glacial lake outlet, up slabs past the Terror Glacier, to the notch between Inspiration and McMillan; another guide describes the same traverse north to a glacial lake and a snowfield to the col. Pin coordinates were not assessed (out of scope).
